def colmap(fr, cols):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return {n:(min((r for r in range(64) if a[r][c0]=='W'), default=None),
               max((r for r in range(64) if a[r][c0]=='W'), default=None))
            for n,(c0,c1) in cols}
